messages:
jess: opened PR to add Mariner-4B to the model catalog with special notes for embedding/rerank compatibility and a short migration guide from Mariner-3B. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/13244
nate: nice. can we be explicit about the embedding vector dims and whether the emb API supports batched inputs for reranking? support sees inconsistent expectations.
carla: embedding dims are 1536 for mariner-4b. added that to the card. also added a short example showing batch embeddings usage.
jess: dropping the Python batch snippet here for reviewers so it's easy to copy:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
texts = ["doc1 text", "doc2 text", "doc3 text"]
embs = client.embeddings(model="mariner-4b-embed", input=texts)
# embs is a list of vectors aligned to input order
```
vik: runtime asks we clarify that batched embeddings are limited by max_total_tokens per item and by an overall request payload size; added a note recommending chunking for long docs.
carla: added a tiny rerank example showing how to compute cosine scores client-side with embeddings and then call generate for the top hit. pasted snippet in PR.
nate: product wants a compact perf blurb for embeddings (p50 tokens/sec) and for reranking latency at 1k tokens so customers can estimate cost. can we add one-line numbers?
jess: pasted compact numbers measured at 512 tokens: "embed: median 120 docs/sec (1536 dim); rerank (embed+score+generate top1): median end-to-end 320ms"
vik: runtime highlighted a compatibility footnote: mariner-4b uses a slightly different tokenizer than mariner-3b which shifts token counts by ~+3% for English. added "tokenization delta" note to migration section.
carla: fixed a broken anchor the docs-bot flagged (was linking to /models/mariner-4b#variants but our template uses /models/mariner-4b/variants). updated PR frontmatter with redirect.
docs-bot: preview deployed for PR 13244: https://deploy.preview.redwood/docs/changes/13244  link-checker: 0 broken links
nate: small SDK copy edit: in the Python snippet change method name to `client.embeddings.create` to match v2 SDK naming. also added a one-line streaming vs batch note: "use embeddings.batch for throughput; use streaming/generate for low-latency rerank when you need text outputs."
jess: updated snippets and wording. merging after a final sanity check from runtime.
vik: runtime OK with wording; just callout: "CPU-quant fallback for embeddings is not recommended for documents >2k tokens; prefer GPU or offload to batch jobs."
jess: merged PR and added changelog entry. thanks everyone! :tada:
